title: **Update** Ughhhh....
text:
**Update** Ughhhh..... So I wrote a review a fewmonths ago, not long after I purchased this salt and pepper shaker set. I purchased them on February 28th 2019. I even waited a few weeks to do my review so that I could see how I liked them and they seemed to work great so I wrote my review and gave them five stars.

less than seven months have gone by and the pepper grinder no longer works. Now, I know there's no difference between the pepper grinder and the salt grinderr but the one that I have the pepper in no longer works. That's why I've been forced to change my five star review to a one star review. I'm very sad about that too because this is a nice, stylish salt and pepper grinder set. I hope other people who have purchased these have better luck with them than I did and if you are looking at reviews to decide if you are going to purchase them beware, the prices inexpensive but the quality is not good.
